children: Indian equities are poised for a strong return, supported by nearly $9 billion in recent buying from foreign institutional investors (FIIs). "Our positiveness stems from a rare convergence of valuations, earnings, and oil prices," according to Abhay Laijawala, Managing Director and Chief Investment Officer at Lighthouse Canton. These three tailwinds are setting the foundation for a significant market reversal following a period of severe historical lag.

Between September 2024 and September 2026, India recorded a cumulative underperformance of 65% against the MSCI Emerging Markets index, surpassing previous downturns seen during 1994 to 1996, 2008, and the 2013 taper tantrum.

"That kind of underperformance is enough to make or was enough to have made India irrelevant in global portfolios," Laijawala said. As foreign liquidity returns, the largeap universe is expected to see the first positive reaction.
Within specific sectors, banks are the best positioned to capture this momentum. Bank loan growth for the most recent fortnight reached 95%, supported by extremely positive high-frequency indicators.

High bond yields are expected to drive industries toward banks to fund large capital expenditure requirements. This credit demand will be fueled by three simultaneous capital expenditure cycles currently underway in India: defense, the renewable energy transition, and artificial intelligence (AI) picks and shovels.
These cycles will require considerable capital, translating into strong industrial loan growth for the banking sector.

Beyond financials, consumer discretionary, automobiles, and industrials present attractive opportunities. The industrials space is already demonstrating robust order book momentum, signaling an acceleration in the private sector capital expenditure cycle.

While fundamentals remain strong for pharmaceutical companies, generic drug makers, and hospitals, the current market environment favours other areas. In a strong growth mode, alternative growth sectors are likely to outperform healthcare and pharma.

title: Banks, autos, industrials top picks as market recovery gathers pace: Lighthouse's Laijawala
